clips.title: The story
paras: Speak with Anastasia is an introductory summons directing promising Forsaken mages to Anastasia Hartwell in the Undercity. Dispatched by mage trainer Cain Firesong, the young caster is called to the Magic Quarter to undertake critical work for the magi of the Forsaken. This brief summons sets the stage for investigations out into the blighted lands of Tirisfal Glades.

As nascent spellcasters hone their early talents under the guidance of Cain Firesong in Brill, they are soon directed into the capital. The mages of the Forsaken maintain a dedicated enclave within the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, organizing both arcane scholarship and strategic defensive efforts across Lordaeron. Cain Firesong acts as an evaluator, filtering out mere novices and sending those who demonstrate genuine talent directly to senior practitioners who require capable field hands.

Anastasia Hartwell stands among the prominent mage instructors within the Undercity. Rather than leaving promising students to study trivial incantations in safety, she wastes little time pressing them into service for the Forsaken's territorial and practical interests. Answering her summons is both a rite of passage for arcane practitioners and an induction into the shadowy, pragmatic magical pursuits that define the post-Scourge undead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, Anastasia Hartwell has a task for someone of your talents. Speak with her in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, and prepare yourself for your first task for the mages of the Forsaken.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings, friend. You were wise to answer my call, and wiser still if you heed what I next say...
